anchor: Which character class gets only simple weapons and no armor training, but leans on a presence-based stat and rolls only a d6 per level for hit points?
Is there a class whose starting kit can be a spear, two daggers, a crystal focus, and a pack, or just 50 gold instead?
What fifth-level option lets me fill a wide area with noxious haze that drifts forward each turn and hurts anything breathing it for up to ten minutes?
Which area effect deals 5d8 harm to each creature inside it and re-checks anyone who enters or ends a turn there?
Which no-slot trick lets me fling toxic mist at a creature 30 feet away with a ranged attack roll?
If I'm a level 17 caster, which ranged option's damage climbs to four twelve-sided dice?
When an attack roll is about to hit me, what quick magical ward can I raise to add 5 to my defense until my next turn?
Which 1st-level instant response can make a force-dart spell deal me no harm?
Which 2nd-level magic lets a willing friend I touch see in the dark out to 150 feet for eight hours?
What spell needs a dried carrot as a material component and grants a companion night vision?
What does my otherworldly benefactor keep ready for me at warlock level 9, including a bug swarm and a binding order?
Which otherworldly patron hands warlocks readied flame bursts and sizzling rays at level 3?
What touch-delivered sickness deals 11d8 life-draining harm and keeps going until the victim wins three rolls to resist it?
Which magic leaves a sickened target rolling at a handicap on a chosen ability, and blocks cures unless it passes another roll?
As a rogue, what quick extra move lets me open a locked door or defuse a trap on my turn?
During combat, can my rogue spend a quick extra move to pick a pocket or use an enchanted item?
Which huge winged, scaled creature can burrow underground and exhale a fiery line 40 feet long or a drowsiness-inducing cone?
Does any huge creature perceive nearby things without relying on sight out to 30 feet, see in darkness to 120 feet, and shrug off flame?
Which barbarian ability grants an edge on rolls to dodge incoming hazards, but only when I'm not unable to act?
For a bard, which ability score drives my arcane abilities, and can an instrument stand in as my focus?
If I level up as a bard, can I trade out one readied magic for another that my current slots can handle?
What second-level charm lets me chatter at folks within 60 feet and leaves them with a -10 penalty to noticing things?
Which bard option gives foes already fighting my party an automatic pass on a roll to resist mental sway, while others must roll?
At what level does a rage-focused warrior choose a specialty path that unlocks further abilities, and which path is detailed right after the class write-up?
Which everyday canine has 5 hit points, bites for 1d6 plus 1, and can knock mid-sized foes down on a hit?
Is there an animal with Intelligence 3, a 40-foot walking speed, and night sight to 60 feet that knows no languages?
Which set of four metal fittings for a steed's hooves adds 30 feet of movement when all four are on one animal?
Is there a rare set of pieces that a rider must spend a special action to attach or remove, one at a time, to a steed?
Which small onyx carving becomes a guard dog for six hours and then needs seven days of rest before it can be used again?
Which silver-made carved bird becomes a raven for 12 hours and lets its holder send a beast-courier spell?
As a bard, at what level do I get a second batch of doubled skill bonuses, after starting with two?
Which two bard skills does the class recommend doubling, if you're trained in them, that involve singing or talking people around?
Which background gives me Athletics and Intimidation, with Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution for ability boosts?
What starting kit includes a first-aid kit, a shortbow with 20 arrows, and a quiver, or 50 gold instead?
At ranger level 14, what quick move lets me become unseen until the end of my next turn, usable as many times as my wisdom modifier?
If my Wisdom bonus is zero or negative, can I still become unseen at least once before I get a full night of rest?
Could a hooved animal with 4 hit points climb at 30 feet and deal extra damage when it runs 20 feet straight at a foe?
Which animal has Intelligence 2, Charisma 5, a 40-foot walking speed, and speaks no languages?
Which fifth-level summon lets me pick an air, earth, fire, or water-type spirit that can pin a creature in place, dealing 8d8 damage?
Is there a way to bring forth a floating ghostly entity whose damage matches the type I choose: lightning, thunder, fire, or cold?
What headgear holds three charges and lets me spend one to instantly relocate myself far away, recharging 1d3 charges each dawn?
As a fighter feature at level 3, what range of d20 rolls counts as an exceptional hit for my weapon or fist attacks?
Which large creature has six tentacles reaching 60 feet, reels snared foes up to 30 feet, and climbs ceilings without checks?
Is there a monster whose lashing tentacles can be cut off to release a captive, and then grow back at the start of its next turn?
Which cost-free trick hurls a glowing mote 60 feet for 1d8 light-based damage and outlines the target in dim glow?
Is there a ranged zap that stops an enemy from vanishing from view again until my next turn ends?
What hour-long ritual can bring back someone dead up to 200 years, using 25,000 gold worth of gems, unless the cause was old age?
Can revival magic also restore an undead creature to living form and regrow lost limbs?
What stick-shaped item holds three charges and lets me spend one to sense enchanted objects nearby, recovering 1d3 charges at dawn?
Which large fey creature moves 50 feet and, after biting, lets the next attacker against that victim strike with an edge?
Is there a neutral evil monster that speaks Goblin and can see in the dark out to 60 feet?
Which class rolls a twelve-sided die for hit points and leans on raw might and endurance for its resistance rolls?
What class gets medium armor, shields, and all martial weapons, and picks two skills from a list of six?
Which restless dead creature shows a horrifying face that scares, dealing 2d6 mind damage in a 60-foot cone to those who fail a willpower roll?
Is there a disembodied spirit that can take over a person's body and leave its owner unable to control it?
Which enchanted polearm or long blade maxes out damage dice against objects and inflicts exhaustion on a foe hit by a natural 20?
Which winged large lawful evil creature stings with venom that stops healing, and returns from death in the lower planes with full health?
Is there a creature that shrugs off flame and toxins, and can speak mind to mind across 120 feet?
Which elixir takes off my age by 1d6 plus 6 years, never below 13, and has a 10-percent cumulative chance of aging me instead?
Is there a vial with a beating heart suspended in amber liquid that makes me younger and vanishes when opened?
What two-pound toolset uses Intelligence to spot tainted food or drink with a DC 10 check?
Which tool set lets me craft a simple toxic mix from raw ingredients?
Which flying scavenger bird with 5 hit points gains an edge on attacks when a friend stands within 5 feet of the target?
Is there a slow-walking flyer that moves 50 feet through the air and pecks for 1d4?
After my rapid unarmed barrage lands a hit, what three options can I pick, including shoving a foe 15 feet or knocking it down?
Is there a monk trick that stops an enemy from making its quick counter-swings when I'm moving away, until its next turn begins?
What drinkable item makes me unseen for an hour, but ends early if I attack or deal damage?
Is there a flask that looks empty, feels like liquid, and gives an hour of stealth when swallowed?
Which 4th-level wizardry makes an unseen floating orb I can view through, and lets me move it up to 30 feet per turn?
Can a remote sensor squeeze through a one-inch gap, or does solid stone stop its movement?
When I use my fighter's stamina-burst recovery as a quick extra move, how far can I reposition without drawing free strikes?
What iron bar can be pressed to lock itself in place until someone presses again, even while defying gravity?
If I hang over 8,000 pounds from a pole I've locked in place, what does it do?
